@liggitt  Sorry that I did not write down the details.

I followed the sample-apiserver to build a aggragted API.

https://github.com/kubernetes/sample-apiserver/blob/dc3f58ceb0ae94c8c0b46bd050d6a338dacb5134/pkg/apis/wardle/install/install.go#L28-L33

```go
func Install(scheme *runtime.Scheme) {
	utilruntime.Must(wardle.AddToScheme(scheme))
	utilruntime.Must(v1beta1.AddToScheme(scheme))
	utilruntime.Must(v1alpha1.AddToScheme(scheme))
	utilruntime.Must(scheme.SetVersionPriority(v1beta1.SchemeGroupVersion, v1alpha1.SchemeGroupVersion))
}
```

But I forgot to call `SetVersionPriority`, then it panics. So I checked the source codes and found the slices length check missed.
